events.title: Australian Market Swings To Modest Gains In Mid-market
events.description: The Australian stock market is swinging to modest gains in mid-market moves on Wednesday after opening in the red, extending the gains in the previous two sessions, with the benchmark S&P/ASX 200 moving up to near the 9,150 level, despite the broadly negative cues from Wall Street overnight, with gains in energy, financial and technology stocks partially offset by weakness in mining stocks.

events.title: Asian Markets Trade Mixed
events.description: Asian stock markets are trading mixed on Wednesday, following the broadly negative cues from Wall Street overnight, as hotter-than-expected US inflation data led to renewed concerns about the outlook for interest rates. Meanwhile, crude oil prices declined as concerns of U.S.-Iran re-escalation faded after U.S. President Donald Trump agreed to maintain a status quo in the Middle East crisis.

events.title: Indian Shares Seen Opening Higher As Oil Holds Near Two-month Lows
events.description: Indian shares are seen opening higher on Wednesday as investors keep an eye on falling crude oil prices and soaring U.S. Treasury yields.

events.title: Thai Stock Market May Open In The Red On Wednesday
events.description: The Thai stock market has tracked higher in back-to-back sessions, advancing more than 30 points or 2.1 percent along the way. The Stock Exchange of Thailand now sits just beneath the 1,500-point plateau although it may open to the downside on Wednesday.

events.title: Japanese Market Notably Higher
events.description: The Japanese stock market is trading notably higher on Wednesday, extending the gains in the previous two sessions, despite the broadly negative cues from Wall Street overnight. The Nikkei 225 is moving above the 60,900 level, with gains in financial and technology stocks partially offset by weakness in automaker stocks.

events.title: Lower Open Tipped For Indonesia Stock Market
events.description: The Indonesia stock market has moved higher in five straight sessions, advancing almost 220 points or 4.5 percent along the way. The Jakarta Composite Index now sits just above the 5,125-point plateau although it's due for consolidation on Wednesday.

events.title: Australian Market Slightly Lower
events.description: Australian shares are trading slightly lower on Wednesday, reversing some of the gains in the previous two sessions, with the benchmark S&P/ASX 200 well below the 9,150 level, following the broadly negative cues from Wall Street overnight, with weakness in mining stocks nearly offset by gains in energy, financial and technology stocks.

events.title: Soft Start Seen For Hong Kong Stock Market
events.description: The Hong Kong stock market on Tuesday ended the two-day slide in which it had dropped more than 350 points or 1.4 percent. The Hang Seng now sits just above the 24,550-point plateau although it may open under water again on Wednesday.

events.title: China Stock Market May Be Stuck In Neutral On Wednesday
events.description: The China stock market has moved higher in consecutive trading days, gathering more than a dozen points or 0.3 percent along the way. The Shanghai Composite Index now sits just above the 3,660-point plateau although the rally may stall on Wednesday.

events.title: Tech Shares May Weigh On Taiwan Stock Market
events.description: The Taiwan stock market has climbed higher in two straight sessions, accelerating almost 2,000 points or 5 percent in that span. The Taiwan Stock Exchange now sits just above the 42,710-point plateau although it may be stuck in neutral on Wednesday.

events.title: Singapore Stock Market May Remain Rangebound
events.description: The Singapore stock market has finished higher in two of three trading days since the end of the five-day losing streak in which it had slumped almost 130 points or 2.5 percent. The Straits Times Index now sits just beneath the 5,260-point plateau although it may hand back those gains on Wednesday.

events.title: Malaysia Stock Market May Test Support At 1,600 Points
events.description: The Malaysia stock market has alternated between positive and negative finishes through the last four trading days since the end of the three-day winning streak in which it had gathered almost a dozen points or 0.7 percent. The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index now sits just above the 1,600-point plateau and it may extend its losses on Wednesday.

events.title: Rally May Stall For Japan Stock Market
events.description: The Japan stock market has finished higher in back-to-back sessions, advancing more than 3,000 points or 5 percent in that span. The Nikkei 225 now sits just above the 60,450-point plateau although investors may lock in gains on Wednesday.
